# What this changes

A sentence or two on what the change does and why.

## Checks

- [ ] `swift build -c release` succeeds
- [ ] `.build/release/vitals --selftest` passes
- [ ] `python3 scripts/test-mcp.py .build/release/vitals` passes, if the MCP surface changed
- [ ] Readings verified on a real Apple Silicon Mac, if sensors changed
- [ ] Docs updated, if behavior or the interface changed

## Notes for the reviewer

Anything worth knowing: a design trade-off, a thing you were unsure about, a follow-up you left for later.
